text:
Evelyn (Eng): Heads up — I'll be working from Porto for 6 weeks starting May 5. Quick q on process: do I need to officially declare this as a temporary remote hub? Also how does the WFH stipend/proration work for a 6-week stay?
Jordan (People Ops): Yep please declare it. For anything >14 days we ask for a temporary remote declaration so we can check payroll & benefits impact. Can you fill the short form? https://intra.redwood/people/remote-declare (link)
Evelyn (Eng): Got it, filing now. For stipend: do we get the monthly WFH allowance pro-rated or a one-time top-up?
Priya (Benefits): We prorate the recurring WFH allowance on a daily basis. For a 6-week window we'll pro-rate the monthly amount for the days you are outside your home base. If you need equipment shipping reimbursement, upload receipts to the same form.
Evelyn (Eng): Cool. Does payroll need any homebase change for tax withholding? I won't be changing my legal home base — just temporary travel.
Carlos (Payroll): If legal home base stays the same, payroll withholding doesn't change for the duration. But Tax team needs to confirm whether the 6-week stay creates any local tax registration or nexus risk. I'll loop them in.
TaxBot: Automated note: Stays <90 days generally low nexus risk but country-specific rules apply. Please await confirmation from Legal/Tax.
Sofia (Legal): +1 to TaxBot. Portugal has visitor rules but 6 weeks is usually fine. We still need the dates and any client-facing work locations. Please add project locations to the form so we can do a quick check.
Evelyn (Eng): I'm working from Porto on internal infra tasks, no client travel. Form submitted: dates + no client contact.
Jordan (People Ops): Thanks. Next steps: 1) People Ops reviews form (done) 2) Payroll flagged (Carlos) 3) Legal quick check (Sofia) 4) Benefits prorate (Priya) 5) Shipping/reimbursement if needed (upload receipts). Expect confirmation by EOD tomorrow.
Carlos (Payroll): Noted. No payroll action required if home base unchanged. Marking internal note so payroll knows to skip homebase cutover.
Priya (Benefits): Once we process proration it'll show on your next stipend payment cycle. If you want a mid-cycle manual adjustment let me know and we can do a one-off.
Evelyn (Eng): One-off would be nice — can avoid juggling partial months. What do you need from me?
Priya (Benefits): Send me the form confirmation + travel dates here and I can request the manual payment. Refunds/reimbursements go to expenses@redwood.com (attach receipts).
Sofia (Legal): Confirmed — no nexus flags from Legal for these dates and tasks. No additional steps from Legal.
Evelyn (Eng): Amazing, thanks all!
Jordan (People Ops): Closing loop: Evelyn — you should get an email summary in ~10–15m with confirmation and the stipend action. Ping @people-ops if anything changes. :thumbsup:
